CreateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterKey: FilterKey: rate-limiting keywords. Multiple keyword groups separated by commas, supporting the utf8 charset. Except for commas used as keywords, commas can only be used as separators; no other restrictions apply.
CreateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterLimit: FilterLimit: concurrency of the rate-limiting rule, ranging from 0 to 1,000,000 (inclusive)
CreateMysqlRateLimitTask.filterType: FilterType: SQL rate-limiting type: SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE
